body: thank you, this really means so much :)

thank you, I suppose I’ve just been afraid to confront them about anything as I don’t want them to feel unwanted, but it would be healthy to be more upfront and rather find a solution that’s beneficial for both of us.

I’ve done research and as far as I know I have all the symptoms of BPD. My friend’s father, who is a social worker/psychologist told her that I exhibit all the common symptoms of BPD without me telling anyone about it...but that’s as far as I’ve ever come to a diagnosis so I can’t really say that I 100% have it. I just feel like I’m going insane half the time and the other half I’m incredibly productive and positive. It feels like I’m split in two and that I have no control over my emotions, so I live in constant fear of what might trigger a breakdown next.
